product_one_liner.value: Upstage provides enterprise language models and document-processing AI that extract information and automate document-heavy workflows for businesses in insurance, financial services, healthcare and manufacturing.

employee_band.notes: Based on the reported workforce of 260, rather than the broader profile size label.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies San Jose as headquarters; Upstage also describes itself as headquartered in South Korea and says its US headquarters launched in 2025. Headquarters records also identify Yongin-si, South Korea.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts cover Solar pretraining and depth up-scaling, document layout analysis and markdown conversion, and the implementation of an internal RAG system. Named authors include Eujeong Choi and Lucy Park; the RAG article is credited to the Upstage Team.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live posting: AI Research Engineer - LLM Evaluation & Analysis.

model_provider.notes: Upstage develops its own Solar model family; Solar Pro 4 is its commercial flagship LLM.

compliance_certs.notes: Explicitly claims SOC 2 Type 1 and ISO 27001 certification. HIPAA is described as compliant, not certified; ISO 27701 is outside the five requested categories.

last_funding.notes: The company’s April 15 announcement reports US$135 million; third-party USD conversions differ. On November 9, NVIDIA participation in a second tranche was announced as forthcoming, with amount undisclosed, not a completed financing.

raised_18mo.notes: Series C first close announced April 15, 2026, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting: SDR (Sales Development Representative), one-year fixed-term contract.

launched_6mo.notes: Solar Pro 4 launched August 20, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No verified Upstage C-level or VP-level joining or departure announcement was found for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026, and no complete, dated leadership roster established a negative. Reports about AXZ leadership were not treated as Upstage executive changes.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Named in CRM/sales-automation experience requirements and marketing-job descriptions; these are hiring signals, not independent proof of deployment of both systems.
